title: Traceable acceptance chain for the covered behaviour
statement: The fictional ESS example retains a linked requirement, integration result and acceptance record for one covered enrollment behaviour
limitation: Covers acceptance criterion AC-3 only; it establishes nothing about waitlist promotion or other ESS workflows

title: End-to-end propagation evidence is retained
statement: The fictional RIS packet records the intended reporting handoff and a contract-compatibility check, and retains evidence that an approved status reaches the downstream extract
limitation: Absence of a retained example is not proof that no manual or undocumented check occurs

title: Propagation evidence is representative rather than complete
statement: The fictional IAM packet demonstrates propagation to one of seven dependent applications; the remaining six have no propagation evidence either way
limitation: One verified consumer must not be read as coverage of the other six, and their outcome is unknown rather than failing
